# Press Releases
25, 2025 / [PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/)/ -- Veralto (NYSE: VLTO) (the "Company"), a global leader in essential water and product quality solutions dedicated to Safeguarding the World's Most Vital Resources™, announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire In-Situ for $435 million, subject to customary closing adjustments.
